growth_signal.value: Raised EUR 80.2M in six months; named in VivaTech Top 100 Rising European Startups 2026.

raised.value: $93M across rounds, including a $53M Series B (June 2025)

entry.idea: People from India who live abroad struggle to send and manage money across borders, so Aspora gives them one account that works in many countries.
entry.lesson: Pick one group with a shared, expensive problem and serve them better than the big banks do.
entry.name: Aspora

growth.basis: substitute: funding round bigger than the last
growth.reason: Fast fundraising and a Series B bigger than earlier rounds, but no user numbers in the dossier.

market.reason: Tens of millions of people in the Indian diaspora move money across borders.

tech.reason: Solid banking and payments engineering, but a good team could copy it.

entry.twist: It is built only for the Indian diaspora, not for everyone.
entry.who_pays: Customers pay small fees on money transfers and banking products.
entry.why_now: Millions of Indians live abroad and send money home, and digital banking now makes a cross-border account cheap to run.
